evidence.text: 149 scenario questions; 831 collected factual questions, of which 773 have valid reference information. Different collection dates and concurrency are retained. Full-page bodies are not part of the scoring input.

zh.Align the factual question population an: 按公开报告更新为 831 道事实题，并同步评分与耗时。
zh.Uses the 831 valid factual questions in: 使用关联报告中的 831 道有效事实题。质量评分与耗时均覆盖这 831 道题；报告未提供与 Hugging Face 某个固定版本的逐题对应关系。
zh.Output layers are scored separately. L2: 各输出层独立评分。L2、L3 使用同一次 API 调用的耗时。
zh.Methods were collected on different date: 各方案在不同日期、不同并发条件下采集，耗时不属于同一时间窗口内的受控对比。
zh.Quoted prices retain each service’s bill: 报价沿用各服务的计费口径，不代表本次评测的总成本。
zh.All 831 recorded calls. Methods were col: 覆盖 831 次调用。各方案在不同日期、不同并发条件下采集。
